title: The image of a C¹ map ℝ^m → ℝ^P is covered by an H^m-null set and countably many embedded C¹ m-submanifolds
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), μHE[m] N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ l, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (N l)) ∧ Set.range G ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ l, N l
